# @ndigo/service

Typed service clients and server-sent event streaming for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `MappedServiceInterceptor`
- `ServiceExecutionChain`
- `likeCompletionAwareServiceInterceptor`
- `likeErrorAwareServiceInterceptor`
- `likeInitializationAwareServiceInterceptor`
- `likeRequestAwareServiceInterceptor`
- `likeResponseAwareServiceInterceptor`
- `likeServiceInterceptor`
- `ServiceInit` *(type)*
- `ServiceInterceptor` *(type)*
- `CompletionAwareServiceInterceptor` *(type)*
- `ErrorAwareServiceInterceptor` *(type)*
- `InitializationAwareServiceInterceptor` *(type)*
- `RequestAwareServiceInterceptor` *(type)*
- `ResponseAwareServiceInterceptor` *(type)*
- `ServiceRegistry` *(type)* — Interface for a service registry that maps service tokens to endpoints.
- `MapServiceRegistry` — Implementation of the ServiceRegistry using an in-memory Map.
- `TelemetryHooks` *(type)* — Interface for telemetry hooks that track service request lifecycles.
- `EventEmitterTelemetryHooks` — Telemetry hooks implementation that uses an EventEmitter to notify about service events.
- `RequestIdCorrelation` *(type)* — Interface for request-ID correlation across service calls.
- `CryptoRequestIdCorrelation` — Request-ID correlation implementation using crypto.randomUUID().
- `service` — `@service(name, config)` — class decorator declaring a named service client.
- `getCall` — Declares a GET service call.
- `postCall` — Declares a POST service call.
- `putCall` — Declares a PUT service call.
- `deleteCall` — Declares a DELETE service call.
- `patchCall` — Declares a PATCH service call.
- `queryCall` — Declares a QUERY service call (RFC 9889 — safe method with a body).
- `getServiceConfig` — Reads the service config recorded by `@service`.
- `getServiceCalls` — Reads the call configs recorded by `@*Call`.
- `SERVICE_METADATA_KEY` — Metadata key under which `@service` writes its config.
- `SERVICE_CALL_METADATA_KEY` — Metadata key (prefix) under which `@*Call` writes per-method call config.
- `ServiceClientConfig` *(type)* — Configuration for a `@service`-decorated client.
- `ServiceCallConfig` *(type)* — Configuration for a `@*Call`-decorated method.
- `serviceClient` — Builds a runtime service client from `@service`/`@*Call` metadata.
- `fillPathTemplate` — Fills `:name` path-template slots from argument values in order.
- `resolveCallBody` — Builds the body for a call: the first object (non-`Request`/`Response`) argument becomes JSON; otherwise no body is sent.
- `SERVICE_NAME_HEADER` — Header carrying the service name for correlation/tracing.
- `parseServerSentEvents` — Parses an async chunk stream into Server-Sent Events.
- `ServerSentEventParser` — Incremental parser for `text/event-stream` content.
- `ServerSentEvent` *(type)*
